Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the

additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Bidder has to upload item wise compliance of items that they are willing to supply all the listed items in the bid specification document. 4. Bidder should submit a certificate certifying that they have not been debarre d or blacklisted by any Go vt.Organization. 5. Bidder should prepare the financial document in such a way that Price of eac h quoted item should be in clusive of GST which should be mentioned at the last column of boq document. 6. The Bidder has to upload/furnish Manufacturer authorization certificate from t he OEM for which they ha ve quoted in the Bid. 7. Bidder should clearly submit an undertaking that they have quoted for each item in the specific Lot. Non -submission of this undertaking will disqualify the Bi dder. Since, the comparison will be made Lot wise it is compulsory that the Bidd er quotes for each item of the Lot. 8. Part supply of Goods/ supply of goods devoid of the specifications will Debar t he Bidder from participati on in all future Bids. 9. ICAR-CRIDA is not liable for any Loss/ Damage during the transport. Damage d goods, if any, has to be r eplaced within 10 days. 10. All the products supplied should be from the Recent Batch. Any products su pplied, whose manufacturi ng date is eight months prior the supply shall not be considered. 11. The Products supplied should have minimum shelf life of One Year. .
